claim.claim-text: 2. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 1, wherein the depilation mechanism (22) comprises a cold compress portion (221) and a emitter (222), the emitter (222) is located between the cold compress portion (221) and the fan (211), the emitter (222) is located in the first channel.

3. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the fan (211) comprises a first heat dissipation fin (2114), which is disposed at and covers the fan air inlet (2111), the first heat dissipation fin (2114) faces the inlet (11).

4. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 1-3, wherein a second heat dissipation fin (2123) is at an upper end of the heat conductive component (212), the second heat dissipation fin (2123) is located in the second channel.

5. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 4, wherein an outer surface of the heat conductive component (212) and an inner wall of the shell are enclosed to form a space which is located in the second channel, and the second vent (2122) is formed at the fan air outlet (2112) in an attachment manner, the second heat dissipation fin (2123) is disposed in the space and faces one of the at least two outlets.
6. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 4 or 5, wherein the second heat dissipation fin (2123) is designed as a fin structure, which has a function of guiding the air.

7. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 1-6, wherein the depilation mechanism (22) also comprises a refrigeration element (223), the refrigeration element (223) is located in the second channel.

8. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 7, wherein the heat dissipation mechanism (21) further comprises a heat conductive element (2113), a first portion of the heat conductive element (2113) is disposed between the fan air inlet (2111) and the one inlet (11), the air is introduced from the one inlet (11) on the shell (1), the first portion of the heat conductive element (2113) is provided with the first heat dissipation fin (2114), and a second portion of the heat conductive element (2113) extends to a refrigeration element (223).

9. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim any one of claims 1-8, wherein when being connected, the fan (211) and the heat conductive component (212) are sleeved on the first vent (2121) through the fan air outlet (2112).

10. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 9, wherein a size of the fan air outlet (2112) is greater than a size of the first vent (2121), an extra gap forms the second vent (2122), so that air is divided into two directions in the first vent (2121) and the second vent (2122).

11. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 1-10, wherein a second outlet (14) is disposed on one side of the one inlet (11), the second outlet (14) and the one inlet (11) are disposed on a side surface of the shell (1) near one end of a heat conductive element (2113), and a first outlet (15) is located at an end portion of the shell (1) away from the heat conductive element (2113), so that air of the first channel completely passes through an inside of the shell (1), and simultaneously takes the heat inside the shell (1) out, and an air inlet direction of the one inlet (11) is parallel to an air outlet direction of the second outlet (14), and the air inlet direction of the one inlet (11) is perpendicular to an air outlet direction of the first outlet (15).

12. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 1-11, further comprising: a circuit apparatus (3) and a power supply apparatus (4), wherein the circuit apparatus (3) and the power supply apparatus (4) are located inside the shell (1), and the circuit apparatus (3) and the power supply apparatus (4) are located in a second region, wherein the first channel passes through the second region.

13. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to claim 12, wherein the circuit apparatus (3) and the power supply apparatus (4) are electrically connected to the refrigeration element (223), the refrigeration element (223) is a semiconductor refrigeration element, the refrigeration element (223) comprises a refrigeration surface (2232) and a heating surface (2231), wherein the refrigeration surface (2232) and the heating surface (2231) are disposed opposite to each other, and the refrigeration surface (2232) of the refrigeration element (223) is tightly attached to the cold compress portion (221), to cool the cold compress portion (221); and the heating surface (2231) of the refrigeration element (223) is connected to a heat conductive element (2113), to dissipate the heat and also cool the cold compress portion (221).

14. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 1-13, wherein the at least two outlets further comprise a third outlet (16), and the third outlet (16) is in communication with an internal cavity of the shell (1).

15. The portable depilation instrument (100) according to any one of claims 4-6, wherein the heat conductive component (212) is provided with a third vent (2124) at the second heat dissipation fin (2123), the third vent (2124) faces a guiding direction of the second heat dissipation fin (2123), and the third vent (2124) is in communication with the first vent (2121).
